summary: List Ecrion Xml and Template for Meetings
description: Returns Ecrion Xml and Template for all Meetings on the Project.

200.description: Ecrion Template and Xml returned successfully

schema.description: The PDF template and per-meeting Ecrion XML used to render Meeting PDFs.

pdf_template.description: The PDF template applied when generating the Meeting PDFs.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the PDF template.

pdf_filename.description: File name of the uploaded PDF template. Null when no file is set.

name.description: Display name of the PDF template.

url.description: Download URL for the PDF template file.

storage_type.description: Storage backend the PDF template is served from when passed to Ecrion. Either `govcloud` or `default`.

meetings.description: Per-meeting Ecrion rendering data, one entry per Meeting on the Project.

id.description: Identifier of the Meeting this Ecrion data belongs to.

name.description: File name to use for the generated Meeting PDF.

xml.description: Ecrion XML payload describing the Meeting's contents for PDF generation.
